newsitem.title: USA: No U.S. corp bond issues scheduled Friday - dealers.
newsitem.headline: No U.S. corp bond issues scheduled Friday - dealers.

text.p: U.S. corporate debt issuance will be next to nil on Friday in an abbreviated market session ahead of the last long summer weekend in the U.S., syndicate officials said.
U.S. markets will be closed on Monday for the Labor Day holiday.
Syndicate dealers said no corporate deals are firmly scheduled for Friday and next week's calendar has yet to be created.
"No one is stupid enough to try and push paper out today. There's no one here," one syndicate member said, pointing out most offices are thinly staffed.
Primary market action may well be muted until next Friday after the U.S. employment report is released.
"If the market rallies on the jobs data there will be a lot of new issues flowing in," said one syndicate source.
Market players said September tends to be one of the busiest months and, with the end of quarter approaching, dealers expect business will pick up.
